arxiv-1902-03788.title: Production of open charm and beauty states in pPb collisions with LHCb
arxiv-1902-03788.description: Abstract These proceedings summarize the LHCb measurements of charm- and beauty-hadron production in pPb collisions. The studies are made down to very low- p T p_{\mathrm{T}}\,\,\, of the observed heavy-flavor hadrons using fully reconstructed decays. Nuclear matter effects are quantified via nuclear modification factors and forward-backward production ratios.

arxiv-2104-14813.title: Does Covid-19 Mass Testing Work? The Importance of Accounting for the Epidemic Dynamics
arxiv-2104-14813.creator: Davide Ferrari, Steven Stillman, Mirco Tonin
arxiv-2104-14813.description: Abstract Mass antigen testing has been proposed as a possible cost-effective tool to contain the Covid-19 pandemic. We test the impact of a voluntary mass testing campaign implemented in the Italian region of South Tyrol on the spread of the virus in the following months.

arxiv-2112-13945.title: The self-interacting Dirac fields in FLRW spacetime
arxiv-2112-13945.creator: Anahit Galstian and Karen Yagdjian
arxiv-2112-13945.description: Abstract We prove the existence of global in time solution with the small initial data for the semilinear equation of the spin- 1 2 \frac{1}{2} particles in the Friedmann-Lemaître-Robertson-Walker spacetime. Moreover, we also prove that if the initial function satisfies the Lochak-Majorana condition, then the global solution exists for arbitrary large initial value.

arxiv-2211-06110.title: On the stability of scale-invariant black holes
arxiv-2211-06110.creator: S. Boudet, M. Rinaldi, and S. Silveravalle
arxiv-2211-06110.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by S. Boudet, M. Rinaldi, and S. Silveravalle. Quadratic scale-invariant gravity non minimally coupled to a scalar field provides a competitive model for inflation, characterized by the transition from an unstable to a stable fixed point, both characterized by constant scalar field configurations. We provide a complementary analysis of the same model in the static, spherically symmetric setting, obtaining two Schwarzschild-de Sitter solutions, which corresponds to the two fixed points existing in the cosmological scenario.

arxiv-2212-02427.title: On the stability of the Kawahara equation with a distributed infinite memory Thanks: *Corresponding author.
arxiv-2212-02427.creator: Roberto de A. Capistrano–Filho, Boumediène Chentouf*, Isadora Maria de Jesus
arxiv-2212-02427.description: Abstract . This article will deal with the stabilization problem for the higher-order dispersive system, commonly called the Kawahara equation. To do so, we introduce a damping mechanism via a distributed memory term in the equation to prove that the solutions of the Kawahara equation are exponentially stable, provided that specific assumptions on the memory kernel are fulfilled.

arxiv-2303-07544.title: Closed-Loop Solvability of Linear Quadratic Mean-Field Type Stackelberg Stochastic Differential Games Thanks: This work is supported by National Key Research & Development Program of China (2022YFA1006104), National Natural Science Foundations of China (11971266, 11831010), and Shandong Provincial N
arxiv-2303-07544.creator: Zixuan Li, Jingtao Shi
arxiv-2303-07544.description: Abstract Abstract: This paper is devoted to a Stackelberg stochastic differential game for a linear mean-field type stochastic differential system with a mean-field type quadratic cost functional in finite horizon. The coefficients in the state equation and weighting matrices in the cost functional are all deterministic. Closed-loop Stackelberg equilibrium strategies are introduced which require to be independent of initial states.

arxiv-2305-01319.title: Long-Term Rhythmic Video Soundtracker
arxiv-2305-01319.creator: Jiashuo Yu, Yaohui Wang, Xinyuan Chen, Xiao Sun, Yu Qiao
arxiv-2305-01319.description: Abstract We consider the problem of generating musical soundtracks in sync with rhythmic visual cues. Most existing works rely on pre-defined music representations, leading to the incompetence of generative flexibility and complexity. Other methods directly generating video-conditioned waveforms suffer from limited scenarios, short lengths, and unstable generation quality.

arxiv-2309-14432.title: Quantum Memory: A Missing Piece in Quantum Computing Units
arxiv-2309-14432.creator: Chenxu Liu, Meng Wang, Samuel Stein, Yufei Ding, Ang Li
arxiv-2309-14432.description: Abstract Memory is an indispensable component in classical computing systems. While the development of quantum computing is still in its early stages, current quantum processing units mainly function as quantum registers. Consequently, the actual role of quantum memory in future advanced quantum computing architectures remains unclear.

arxiv-2404-09304.title: Monte Carlo Search Algorithms Discovering Monte Carlo Tree Search Exploration Terms
arxiv-2404-09304.creator: Tristan Cazenave
arxiv-2404-09304.description: Abstract Monte Carlo Tree Search and Monte Carlo Search have good results for many combinatorial problems. In this paper we propose to use Monte Carlo Search to design mathematical expressions that are used as exploration terms for Monte Carlo Tree Search algorithms. The optimized Monte Carlo Tree Search algorithms are PUCT and SHUSS.

arxiv-2411-18689.title: Wheeler-De Witt equation and the Canonical Construction of the Glauber-Sudarshan States in Quantum Gravity
arxiv-2411-18689.creator: Keshav Dasgupta, Fang-Yi Guo, and Bohdan Kulinich
arxiv-2411-18689.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Keshav Dasgupta, Fang-Yi Guo, and Bohdan Kulinich. Quantum gravity is fundamentally different from the non-gravitational quantum field theories in the sense that most of the techniques derived for the latter cannot be easily extended to the former. For example, correlation functions in quantum gravity become hard to define properly if the bulk Hamiltonian − - in the absence of a boundary Hamiltonian, and as a consequence of the Wheeler-De Witt equation − - itself annihilates the states thus rendering the evolution operators to identities.

arxiv-2501-19378.title: TableMaster : A Recipe to Advance Table Understanding with Language Models
arxiv-2501-19378.creator: Lang Cao, Hanbing Liu, Tsinghua University, liuhb24@mails.tsinghua.edu.cn
arxiv-2501-19378.description: Abstract Tables serve as a fundamental format for representing structured relational data. While current language models (LMs) excel at many text-based tasks, they still face challenges in table understanding due to the complex characteristics of tabular data, such as their structured nature. In this paper, we aim to enhance LMs for improved table understanding.

E. Garrett, G. F. Grinyer, E. Gyabeng Fuakye, G. Hackman, R. Jain, K. Kapoor, R. Krücken, A. Laffoley, A. Lennarz, J. Liang, Z
arxiv-2512-12025.description: Abstract Model-observation comparisons of type-I X-ray bursts (XRBs) can reveal the properties of accreting neutron star systems, including the neutron star compactness. XRBs are powered by nuclear burning and a handful of reactions have been shown to impact the model results.

pmc-11271894.description: Avian infectious bronchitis is an acute respiratory disease of poultry of particular concern for global food security. Investigation of infectious bronchitis virus (IBV), the causative agent of avian infectious bronchitis, via reverse genetics enables deeper understanding of virus biology and a rapid response to emerging variants.

pmc-11386381.title: Association of oral frailty and gait characteristics in patients with cerebral small vessel disease
pmc-11386381.creator: Hong-yang Xie, Jun-li Chen, Cui-qiao Xia, Nan Zhang, Zhen-xi Xia, Hong-yi Zhao, Yong-hua Huang
pmc-11386381.description: BackgroundThe objectives of this study were twofold: (1) to compare gait characteristics between cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD) patients with low-risk oral frailty (OF) and high-risk OF, particularly during dual-task walking (DTW); (2) to investigate the association of OF, the gait characteristics of DTW, and falls among older adults patients with CSVD.

pmc-12723141.title: The Combined ALBI-FIB-4 Score for Prognostic Stratification in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Single Center Retrospective Study
pmc-12723141.creator: Doğan Bayram, Efe Cem Erdat, Sema Nur Özsan Çelebi, Serap Türk, Serhat Sekmek, Perihan Perkin, Selin Aktürk Esen, Gökhan Uçar, Mehmet Ali Nahit Şendur, Doğan Uncu, Fahriye Tuğba Köş, Burak Civelek
pmc-12723141.description: BackgroundHepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is influenced not only by tumor burden but also by liver function and the extent of fibrosis. Although the albumin-bilirubin (ALBI) score and the fibrosis-4 (FIB-4) index are validated independent predictors, their combined prognostic impact has been insufficiently examined.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed 307 patients with HCC diagnosed between 2002 and 2025.

pmc-13094381.title: User Experience and Early Clinical Outcomes of a Mental Wellness Chatbot for Depression and Anxiety: Pilot Evaluation Mixed Methods Study
pmc-13094381.creator: Scott Graupensperger, Emily J Ward, Graham Baum, Kate H Bentley, Emily R Dworkin, Millard Brown, Adam Chekroud, Matt Hawrilenko, Ivan Steenstra
pmc-13094381.description: BackgroundArtificial intelligence–powered conversational agents (ie, chatbots) are increasingly popular outlets for users seeking psychological support, yet little is known about how users experience early-stage prototypes or which therapeutic processes contribute to clinical improvement. A transparent evaluation of emerging chatbot prototypes is needed to clarify if, how, and why artificial intelligence companions work and to guide their continued development.

uslaw-usc-t12-s624.title: 12 U.S.C. § 624 — Appointment of receiver or conservator
uslaw-usc-t12-s624.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t12-s624.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 6 (Foreign Banking); Subchapter II (Organization Of Corporations To Do Foreign Banking). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (A) In general.— The Board may appoint a conservator or receiver for a corporation organized under the provisions of this subchapter to the same extent and in the same manner as the Comptroller of the Currency.

uslaw-usc-t16-s667f1.title: 16 U.S.C. § 667f–1 — Requisition of grain to prevent crop depredation by migratory waterfowl
uslaw-usc-t16-s667f1.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s667f1.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 5A (Protection And Conservation Of Wildlife); Subchapter I (Game, Fur-Bearing Animals, And Fish). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Upon a finding by the Secretary of the Interior that any area in the United States is threatened with damage to farmers’ crops by migratory waterfowl, whether or not during the open season for such migratory waterfowl.
